description:
Brrr It's Cold: Why Do We Shiver and Chattering Teeth? — Brrr, it's freezing outside! Your teeth start chattering and your body shakes! Why does your body start shivering on purpose?
Kids science answer for "why do we shiver science for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When your skin sensors detect freezing temperatures, your brain's hypothalamus triggers rapid involuntary muscle spasms—shivering—which burns energy and generates internal emergency heat to warm you up!
